requirements.label: The system must accept any story input and understand it completely.
The system must understand characters as complete psychological entities, not name tags.
The system must maintain perfect continuity across the entire narrative.
The system must support natural, emotionally engaging conversation with AI creative roles and characters.
The system must support the full spectrum of human involvement.
The system must apply creative style and taste.
The system must support rapid iterative generation — the core creative loop.
The system must produce professional-grade production artifacts.
The system must export to professional formats with embedded narrative intelligence.
The system must show a playable assembly at every stage.
The system must show production readiness per scene.
Every AI decision must be explainable and overridable.
The system must learn from user choices.
Nothing is ever lost. No decision is final.
Changes propagate intelligently through the dependency graph.
The system must accept real-world production assets as first-class inputs at any point in the workflow.
The system must support multi-human collaboration.

state.product_need: Artifacts, decisions, and runtime operations stay immutable, auditable, and safe to revise.
state.tech_need: Snapshot versioning, dependency-aware invalidation, AI/runtime boundary discipline, and durable audit metadata.
notes: Core substrate exists. Current work here is mostly maintenance, decomposition, and verification hardening rather than a missing-system climb.

state.product_need: CineForge can accept story inputs in multiple formats and turn them into a coherent, browsable understanding quickly enough to start creative work.
state.tech_need: Ingestion, normalization, canonical script handling, project configuration, script-bible extraction, and scene understanding.
notes: The two-tier scene split remains justified while single-pass scene understanding is still below the required quality/latency bar.
Long-form screenplay throughput is a standing climb requirement: measure the honest story-lane boundary and use detector-backed stage budgets instead of anecdotal 'the pipeline feels slow' tuning.

state.product_need: Characters, locations, props, and continuity states persist as first-class world knowledge.
state.tech_need: Bible folders, relationship edges, and state snapshots over story time.
notes: Core substrate exists. Remaining work is mostly quality refinement, continuity detection depth, and better downstream reuse of the world model.

state.product_need: Creative roles and characters should feel like collaborators who understand the story deeply and shape it across disciplines.
state.tech_need: Role hierarchy, style packs, transcripts, suggestion artifacts, and concern-group direction artifacts.
notes: Capability gating remains an honest hold-state compromise until one broadly usable multimodal model removes the need for per-role modality declarations.

state.product_need: The operator should feel like they are working with their story, not administering a pipeline.

state.product_need: CineForge can compile direction into generation requests and carry user-provided assets through the same pipeline.

state.product_need: AI cost, quality, and model tradeoffs are visible enough that operators can trust the system.

state.product_need: Long-running collaboration should preserve context, transcripts, and operating-mode intent without losing provenance.

notes: The canonical vs working-memory split remains justified while context windows and memory persistence are still constrained.

lines: - **Phase 0 — Foundation** (001–002): Project scaffolding and pipeline infrastructure. Artifact store with immutability, snapshot versioning, dependency graph, audit metadata, cost tracking hooks, and structural validation.

- **Phase 3 — Timeline** (012–013): Timeline data artifact with scene/story ordering, stacked tracks, and always-playable rule.
- **Phase 4 — Role System** (014–019): Role hierarchy, Director + Canon Guardians, style pack loading, suggestion/decision lifecycle, inter-role communication, and human interaction modes.
- **Phase 5 — Creative Direction** (020–023, 093–097, 099–100): Intent-first director's vision model, concern groups, and scene workspace.

- **Phase 7 — Generation** (028–030, 140): Render adapter, user asset injection, generated-output QA, and media validation.
